description: Get the dated captures of one app's paywall and onboarding, newest first, and what changed between them. Each capture (run) gives when it was recorded, the app version on the phone when known (version_source phone, or store for the live store version at capture), archived (true once a newer capture replaced it; its screen files are kept copies), and its flows with every screen's position, file, on-screen text, main button and, on paywall screens we have read, paywall: plans, prices, trial days, preselected plan, close and main button. changes lists what differed between two captures (price, trial, plans, default_plan, close_button, main_button, social_proof, steps, paywall_position, screen_text) with before and after, and a note. A change was observed between two captures of one phone: it can be a redesign, a price change or one arm of an A/B test, and is never proof of a test. An app with no dated capture answers an empty list. Needs an active Social Growth Engineers subscription; other keys are refused.

app_id.description: App Store ID of an app we captured (from list_design_apps or search_designs)

limit.description: Captures to return, newest first (1-20, default: 5)

pattern.description: Only paywall or only onboarding flows and changes. Default: both

name: get_design_history
title: Get an app's paywall and onboarding history
